s1.text: This is Jubilee Open Hands. Five friends who decided to save together.

s2.text: Paulz, M S, Elis, Emma, and James each put in five hundred rupees, every month.

s3.text: From June to October, every single member paid. Twenty five hundred rupees, every month.

s4.text: In November, four of five payments came in.

s5.text: Together, we collected fourteen thousand, five hundred rupees.

s6.text: In November, we sponsored the U E S I Churachandpur Diamond Jubilee Celebration. One thousand rupees from each of us, five thousand in all.

s7.text: That leaves nine thousand, five hundred rupees in our jar. Open hands, growing together. Scroll down to explore our numbers.
